data.question: Seven planets are named after Roman or Greek gods. Which planet is the odd one out?
data.explanation: Earth. Its name comes from Old English words for ground and soil.
data.answer_full: Earth. Its name comes from Old English words for ground and soil.

data.question: Parmesan cheese, Parma ham and balsamic vinegar of Modena all come from one double-barrelled Italian region beginning with E. Name it.
data.explanation: Emilia-Romagna, home to Parma and Modena.
data.answer_full: Emilia-Romagna, home to Parma and Modena.
